name: Drift Protocol $285M Multisig
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the RevertIQ label and description.
rootCause: Drift Protocol on Solana suffered a $285M loss in April 2026 when an attacker exploited multisig governance using durable nonce accounts and social engineering. The attacker gained admin rights via pre-signed, delayed-execution transactions and drained vaults in minutes by fabricating a collateral market with a worthless token. The incident resulted from a breakdown in Drift Protocol's multisig approval process. Social engineering led two Security Council members to pre-sign administrative durable nonce transactions.
